reviews.title: Newer cloud Full Simulation records contain account-level traces; risk blocks are not breaches
reviews.finding: The latest cloud workspace contains four Full Simulation records with sample account traces, alongside a newer Calculate Investment optimizer summary. In two distinct inspected full-simulation samples, every sample account marked exhausted had a corresponding blocked event explicitly stating that the next risk tier exceeded remaining drawdown without an account breach. Sample paid transitions had paid-day markers. Three earlier runs share matching sample event counts and status distributions, so repeated output alone is not evidence of a calculation defect. These are stored hypothetical simulations, not live trading results.
reviews.suggestion: Compare blocked-event counts, loss events, firm-breach events, and payout transitions by run and policy before interpreting exhausted as a failed challenge. For future review, retain account sample traces and a fixed seed; distinguish Calculate Investment aggregates from Full Simulation event traces.
measurements: New cloud records inspected: 5 history records (4 Full Simulation, 1 Calculate Investment)
Two distinct Full Simulation samples inspected: 33 and 50 account traces
Blocked events in those samples: 22 and 38, respectively; all correspond to exhausted sample accounts
No sampled exhausted account lacked a blocked event; no sampled paid account lacked a paid-day marker
Manual Section 11 request IDs found in inspected cloud profiles: none
reviews.action: Published evidence clarification only; no trading risk policy or simulation engine changes. Prior generic claim that recent cloud history lacks account-level traces does not apply to these newer Full Simulation records.
reviews.source: Private connected Google Drive 4Ds Trading Studio Cloud Data snapshot structure and sample trace event categories, summarized without personal data; current GitHub simulator code and existing public research history.
reviews.verified: Cloud snapshot inspected through 2026-11-07T17:56:31Z. Two distinct samples checked for event/status consistency. Not a full Monte Carlo replay, independent trading audit, or live Cloudflare verification. No new manual request was present; no request ID was processed.

reviews.title: Recent repeated optimizer results passed basic consistency checks
reviews.finding: The newest retained cloud history remained Calculate Investment summaries rather than account-level Full Simulation traces. Two newer summaries matched previously retained same-input scenario results. Across retained optimizer candidate records, internal net-cash arithmetic, ROI definitions, ordered account funnel counts and bounded goal probabilities passed targeted consistency checks. This does not validate real trading outcomes or the accuracy of model assumptions.
reviews.suggestion: For an individual blocked or funded account, save a new Full Simulation with sample event traces; then test risk-headroom and closure labels instead of diagnosing from optimizer aggregates. Compare future changes using fixed inputs and paired seeds.
measurements: Number of new distinct scenario fingerprints versus repeated saved calculations
Checks of net equals receipts minus incurred costs and ROI equals net over spend
Account-funnel monotonicity and goal probabilities within zero to one
Number of Full Simulation records containing account-level sample trace events
reviews.action: Research-only analysis. No trading strategies, per-phase risks or engine behavior were changed.
reviews.source: Connected private cloud history, summarized without financial values or account identifiers; GitHub portfolio-engine.js preflight and history serializer.
reviews.verified: Aggregate candidate consistency checks passed; repeated history is not by itself a defect. Account-level cause, live performance and a new complete cloud simulation trace remain unverified.

reviews.title: Review-request delivery needs a cloud-capacity and readback check
reviews.finding: The Section 11 review-request client saves an entire profile snapshot and refuses a write above its 850,000-character guard. A connected cloud snapshot was found close to that cap, so adding queue entries or more simulation history may hit the storage guard. No queued manual request was present in the inspected snapshot; this does not establish that the request form has failed, because a successful test submission was not observed.
reviews.suggestion: Submit one non-sensitive manual Section 11 request and confirm its request ID and nonce in the next cloud readback. Track remaining snapshot capacity and prefer a non-destructive data-retention design before changing cloud storage. Avoid silently discarding older private records to make space.
measurements: Serialized snapshot character count as a share of the 850,000-character client cap
Queued request ID and nonce confirmed after cloud round-trip
Explicit cloud-save failure messages and retained-history count
Full-simulation trace retention when profile data grows
reviews.action: Published a capacity warning only; no cloud records deleted or changed, and no risk settings edited.
reviews.source: Connected cloud file structure and GitHub gpt-review-request.js and portfolio-history.js capacity handling.
reviews.verified: Client-side cap and limited remaining headroom verified by read-only inspection. No manual queue write failure, production browser test or cloud-server quota failure was observed.

reviews.finding: A connected cloud history audit found newer Calculate Investment records with candidate-level planSnapshot and phase riskProfiles; earlier retained entries lack those fields. Optimizer entries still have no per-account sample trace, so an individual risk-blocking event or funded-stage closure cannot be reconstructed from those summaries.
reviews.suggestion: Run Full Simulation for the selected model, then confirm a new cloud history record contains firms' risk, caps and sampled account traces before diagnosing an individual account.
measurements: Share of retained optimizer records containing candidate-level planSnapshot
Count of new full-simulation cloud records with sampled account traces
Per-phase risk-policy completeness and trace event counts

reviews.title: Funded-stage risk concerns need event-level diagnosis
reviews.finding: The cloud review log retains an unresolved qualitative funded-risk question. An older RR question had been categorized as general risk, but current source code routes explicit RR wording to the dedicated RR topic. No sampled trade trace was present to establish whether funded risk was excessive, correctly policy-blocked, or breached a drawdown limit.
reviews.suggestion: Use a fresh full-simulation saved trace to examine funded-stage selected tier, effective dynamic risk, residual overall/daily headroom and event closure reasons. Compare risk blocks with actual breaches; request approval before any change to risk sizing.
measurements: Unresolved qualitative advisor questions
Explicit RR prompts routed to dedicated topic
Funded trace events: selected risk, allowed headroom, risk block versus failed status
Same-input baseline versus candidate comparison only after suitable traces exist

reviews.source: Connected Results Advisor review status and GitHub portfolio-payout-ui.js topic routing plus portfolio-engine.js risk preflight

reviews.title: Full account-level reviews need traceable simulation evidence
reviews.finding: Stored optimizer summaries provide aggregate scenarios and risk-tier values, but legacy history does not retain the complete risk-policy snapshot or sampled account trade/closure events. Therefore an individual account's exact blocking trigger cannot be established from optimizer summaries alone.
reviews.suggestion: Analyze the chosen investment model through Run Full Simulation and verify that the saved history includes risk-policy snapshots and sampled trade events. Compare preflight risk, remaining overall and daily loss allowance, risk-blocked status and genuine loss-limit breaches.
measurements: Presence of model plan and phase-specific R1/R2/R3 policy in saved history
Number of sampled account events available
Count of actual drawdown breaches separately from risk-tier blocks
Changes in payout probabilities and blocked counts when risk is reduced at fixed budget
reviews.action: Added an evidence-readiness checker to Section 11 and expanded future history records. Older saved records cannot be automatically backfilled.
reviews.source: Connected simulation-history schema inspection and GitHub simulator/serialization code review
reviews.verified: Source records and JavaScript syntax inspected. End-to-end browser deployment and new-format cloud write not yet independently verified.

reviews.title: Risk-blocked accounts are not firm breaches
reviews.finding: The engine preflights the next configured risk against the remaining overall and daily loss allowance. If the policy cannot take that risk, the account can be removed from simulation routing without an actual loss-limit breach.
reviews.suggestion: Compare lower-risk models at the same budget, trading horizon and paired signal seed. Review per-account closure reasons and remaining headroom before changing strategy settings.
measurements: Compare cumulative risk-blocked versus breached accounts
Check phase-by-phase account survival
Compare expected net, payouts, and downside at equal budget
reviews.action: Improved Account Journey closure reasons and added fixed-budget Compare Lower Risk.
reviews.source: GitHub engine code review; deterministic smoke tests
reviews.verified: Code and deterministic test only; live deployment and real performance unverified
